package greet

import "strings"

// Greet trims the name but returns a plain error for an empty one.
func Greet(name string) (string, error) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		return "", emptyGreet{}
	}
	return "Hello, " + name + "!", nil
}

type emptyGreet struct{}

func (emptyGreet) Error() string { return "name is empty" }
